verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence that user-defined automations exist is a single homepage line saying Copilot configures "automations" from plain-English requests. That implies a native automation feature but documents nothing about event triggers, rule conditions or available actions. Fixed built-in behaviors (auto-logged emails, form-to-deal sync) and the Zapier integration are not user-defined native rules and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of event triggers, rule conditions and action types, a rule-builder UI or API for automations, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests, inside the permissions you already have.
